documentation: Evaporator Cfg_DefrostStartMode code -> text. PLC (L5K CG_RL_Evap): 0 TOD, 1 Liquid Time, 2 Run Time, 3 DI Initiate, 4 AI Initiate. FT (STELLAR)CGDX 3VL/4VL: 0 ToD, 1 Cooling, 2 Runtime (input 0-2, security code F). The HMI selects 0-2 only; 3/4 are display only (selectable false). Read with lookup() or shared.Enums; edit through .cursor/tasks/evap-defrost-strings/build.py.
name: DefrostStartMode

documentation: Evaporator Cfg_CycFans code -> text: fan mode while the unit is idle. PLC (L5K CG_RL_Evap): 'Cycle Fans Mode for When the Unit is in Idle' 0 Fans Off, 1 Cycle Fans, 2 Fans On. FT: 0 Fans Off, 1 Cycle, 2 Fans On (security code F). Read with lookup() or shared.Enums; edit through .cursor/tasks/evap-defrost-strings/build.py.
name: CycleFans

documentation: PLC CG_RL_Evap Sts_State (control group phase, L5K wording) -> hmiStatus = the Devices/Evaporator Status/Value code (0 Off, 1 Cooling, 2 Defrost, 3 Fault, 5 Idle, 6 Pump Down, 7 Hot Gas, 8 Bleed, 9 Fan Delay) for the PAX tag mapping; map taken from the Evaporator UDT Status longDescription. FT captions differ (2 MAIN HOT GAS, 8 HEAT MODE). Status only: nothing writes it. Read with lookup() or shared.Enums; edit through .cursor/tasks/evap-defrost-strings/build.py.
